events.fullDescription:
Equip Indian Churches (EIC) invites you to a one-day conference in Dimapur focused on the theme “A Day in the Word” with expositions from Ephesians chapters 1 and 2. In a time when the church needs strong biblical foundations, this conference seeks to encourage believers through faithful preaching, Christ-centred teaching, and meaningful fellowship.

Join pastors, church leaders, and believers from across the region for a day of learning, encouragement, and spiritual refreshment as we reflect on the riches of the Gospel and God’s saving grace in Christ. The conference will also include opportunities to connect with others, explore resources from For The Truth bookstore, and be strengthened for faithful Christian living and ministry.

We warmly invite you to join us for this special gathering centred on God’s Word.

events.title: AIPC 2026
events.shortDescription: All India Pastors’ Conference
events.fullDescription:
Where Men are Equipped & Renewed
AIPC is a gathering of men who love the church from across India — a space to be grounded in God’s Word, renewed in spirit, and connected with fellow labourers.

Organised by Equip Indian Churches, this conference brings hundreds of men under one roof for teaching, fellowship, and prayer.

 

Conference Theme 2026
“Living as Exiles”
Expositions in 1 Peter
“The grass withers, and the flower falls, but the word of the Lord remains forever. And this word is the good news that was preached to you.”
1 Peter 1:24-25

This year’s conference draws from Peter’s letter to the elect exiles of the Dispersion — reframed as messages to the churches and leaders of the Church in India today.

Together, we will sit under the Word, wrestle with its demands, and be prepared — as Exiles living for Christ in this world.

events.title: All India Pastors Conference (AIPC) 2026: Proclaiming Christ Faithfully
events.shortDescription: The premier annual national gathering of pastors, elders, church planters, and theological students from across India.
events.fullDescription:
### Conference Theme: Proclaiming Christ Faithfully in the 21st Century

The All India Pastors Conference (AIPC) 2026 gathers pastors, leaders, and servants of Christ for three intensive days of biblical instruction, expository sermons, pastoral fellowship, and mutual encouragement.

#### Key Highlights
- **Plenary Expository Addresses** through the Pastoral Epistles.
- **Breakout Workshops** on hermeneutics, sermon preparation, church discipline, and biblical counseling.
- **Pastoral Q&A Panels** addressing the contemporary challenges of shepherding local churches in India.
- **Bookstall & Literature Grants** offering discounted and gifted sound theological resources.

schedules.title: Opening Plenary: The Authority and Sufficiency of Scripture
schedules.description: Expositional message setting the theological foundation of pastoral authority.

schedules.title: Workshop Track A: Hermeneutical Principles for Expository Preaching
schedules.description: Moving from original text to contemporary sermon outline with clarity and fidelity.

schedules.title: Pastoral Panel: Shepherding Local Flocks Through Cultural Pressure
schedules.description: Interactive question and answer session with experienced Indian pastors.

faqs.question: Who should attend this conference?
faqs.answer: Pastors, associate pastors, elders, church planters, deacons, and theological seminary students.

faqs.question: Is accommodation provided with registration?
faqs.answer: Registration covers lunch, tea, conference folder, and literature pack. Accommodations must be booked individually nearby.

faqs.question: Will recordings and transcripts be made available?
faqs.answer: Yes, all plenary messages will be published on the Equip Indian Churches media portal following the conference.

events.fullDescription:
Equip Indian Churches (EIC) is having its first regional conference in Dimapur on the 11th February 2025.

At the EIC LIFE Conference, we will meet and think about basics of the Christian Life. We hope that this one-day conference would be a time of fellowship and encouragement to Churches and Christians in and around Dimapur.

So, if you live in or around Dimapur, we request you to join us and to come and be encouraged, and from God’s Word. The speakers are pastors of local churches from different parts of India who have a deep desire to help fellow believers and pastors around the country to have a better and Biblical understanding of the Christian life.

This event would be a great opportunity to sit under God’s Word, make friends, and network with like-minded brothers and sisters from your city and neighbouring cities.

Topics
1. Faith: What do we believe?
2. Life: How do we live?
3. Community: Where should we belong?
4. Growth: How do Christians mature and multiply?
5. Hope: What are we living for?
Panel discussion/Q&A

events.title: Healthy Churches Conference – Mumbai 2022
events.shortDescription: Topic: Biblical Church Growth Equip Indian Churches (EIC) had their first regional conference for the church in Mumbai in 2020 and had hoped to have a follow-up conference each year. But because of the COVID-19 restricti
events.fullDescription:
Topic: Biblical Church Growth Equip Indian Churches (EIC) had their first regional conference for the church in Mumbai in 2020 and had hoped to have a follow-up conference each year. But because of the COVID-19 restrictions, we were unable to meet last year in 2021. But by God’s grace, we are hoping to meet again to think about Biblical Church Growth. We are hoping that this one-day conference would encourage our brothers and sisters in Mumbai who are keen to grow in the understanding of the Biblical church and also are committed to the preaching of the Gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Given the current circumstances, when so many voices are calling out to get our attention to adopt various models of Church Growth; the Church in Mumbai needs a clear, robust, and Biblical understanding of Ecclesiology (The study of Church) so that our churches can be faithful and rooted in scriptures as we also enjoy true Biblical growth.

Dear friends, if you live in Mumbai or are close to Mumbai, then please take some time out from your busy schedules to come and be encouraged, challenged, and equipped by men who are engaged in serving the church in the various parts of the country. All these men are committed to the ministry of the local church and also have a deep desire to help fellow believers and pastors around the country to have a better and Biblical understanding of the church.

This event would be a great opportunity to make friends and network with like-minded brothers and sisters from your city and neighbouring cities.

By Pastors in India in Association with EIC.

events.title: Summer Course On Ecclesiology – Secunderabad
events.shortDescription: Topic: Study Of The Church The summer course on Ecclesiology is an annual, intensive three-day residential program. The course gives participants an understanding of the meaning and purpose of the local church. This cour
events.fullDescription:
Topic: Study Of The Church

The summer course on Ecclesiology is an annual, intensive three-day residential program. The course gives participants an understanding of the meaning and purpose of the local church. This course also examines and deepens participants’ biblical knowledge in the qualifications of church leaders as well as addressing the importance of membership, discipline, discipleship, and missions within the local church. In addition, topics related to shepherding the flock amid modern-day challenges will be covered. The daily Q&A sessions will give participants the opportunity to explore more on a specific topic, exchange views, and share knowledge. These sessions will be the most engaging part of the workshop.

Who may attend 
This course is available to up to 50 participants to ensure more personal attention and care is given to each participant. The individuals we are encouraging to register and attend include: Pastors or Lay Elders, Seminary Students, Bible College students, Teachers/professors, and Church Members.

Course Fee and Scholarships
The course fee is Rs. 3,750 and is due prior to April 30, 2022. This includes AC accommodation and food. There are a limited number of scholarships available for eligible participants. Please contact the Program Secretary as soon as possible for scholarship eligibility requirements. All scholarships will be awarded by April 15, 2022.

Resource persons and Teaching method
For this workshop the Lord has provided us the opportunity to interact with world renowned pastors and scholars both nationally and internationally. Their experience as pastors will immensely bless the participants with clarity and understanding on the subject of ecclesiology.

The course is designed to use participatory methodology. This method of learning is practical, enjoyable, and memorable for all participants.

Resources and Networking
Participants in this course will have access to additional resources in the areas of church study. Participants will also have opportunities to network with Pastors across the nation. This unique feature will be invaluable to participants going forward as they utilize the knowledge gained from the course in their ongoing ministries.

Time, Travel, and Location
This course is from 17-20 May 2022. Participants are expected to arrive and register by noon on Tuesday, 17 May. The program begins later that day at 4:00 pm and will end with lunch on Friday, 20 May.

Participants are responsible for their own travel expenses and arrangements.

The course will be held at the Seva Bharath Campus (Ashirwad Global), Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India.

events.fullDescription: Topic: Pastoring Through Song Equip Indian Churches is organising an online meeting for Pastors, Elders, Pastoral Interns, Seminary Students, Worship Leaders, and Lay Members on the topic “Pastoring Through Song” by Bro. Bob Kauflin Pastoral ministry has multiple aspects, and pastors are often juggling their attention between various responsibilities. It is understandable that preaching and counselling take up a lot of time and attention, but what role should pastors have in the singing ministry of their church? Do pastors consider singing as a part of their teaching ministry to build up the people of God? In this session, Pastor Bob Kauflin will help us think about the importance of “Pastoring through song.”

events.shortDescription: TOPIC – Biblical Church Growth Equip Indian Churches (EIC) is having its first regional conference for the church in Assam. We hope to have a follow-up conference each year. By God’s grace, we are hoping to meet an
events.fullDescription:
TOPIC – Biblical Church Growth

Equip Indian Churches (EIC) is having its first regional conference for the church in Assam. We hope to have a follow-up conference each year. By God’s grace, we are hoping to meet and think about Biblical Church Growth.

We are hoping that this one-day conference would encourage our brothers and sisters in Assam who are keen to grow in the understanding of the Biblical church and also are committed to the preaching of the Gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Given the current circumstances, when so many voices are calling out to get our attention to adopt various models of Church Growth; the Church in Assam needs a clear, robust, and Biblical understanding of Ecclesiology (The study of Church) so that our churches can be faithful and rooted in scriptures as we also enjoy true Biblical growth.

Dear friends, if you live in Guwahati or are close to Guwahati, then please take some time out from your busy schedules to come and be encouraged, challenged, and equipped by men who are engaged in serving the church in the various parts of the country. All these men are committed to the ministry of the local church and also have a deep desire to help fellow believers and pastors around the country to have a better and Biblical understanding of the church.

 

This event would be a great opportunity to make friends and network with like-minded brothers and sisters from your city and neighboring cities.

events.title: A Workshop On Biblical Exposition
events.shortDescription: Topic – Practical Instruction – Persuasive Preaching – Small Group Practice WHAT IS IT? Preaching The Epistles – 2 Timothy The Workshops on Biblical Exposition is a 3-day training event aimed to e
events.fullDescription:
Topic – Practical Instruction – Persuasive Preaching – Small Group Practice

WHAT IS IT?

Preaching The Epistles – 2 Timothy

The Workshops on Biblical Exposition is a 3-day training event aimed to encourage and equip you in the skills needed to read, understand, and proclaim the Word of God. The Workshop includes times set aside for 1) Principles of Exposition (instructional sessions on how to better handle biblical texts), 2) Small Group Practice (when you will share and receive feedback on two passages), and 3) Expositions (the opportunity to sit under the word). Each of these sessions is carefully designed to be interrelated for the greatest value in improving your work. In other words, this is a Workshop and not a conference. If you cannot be at all the sessions, then it really isn’t for you.

Edifying & instructional commitments in the small group sessions as well as the cumulative relationship between the small group and plenary sessions, full participation is required.

WHO SHOULD ATTEND?

The Workshops on Biblical Exposition are for men who are responsible for regularly preaching and teaching. We also welcome those in bi-vocational ministries as well as those training for ministry. Given our understanding of Scripture, most of our Workshops on Biblical Exposition are for men who are responsible for regularly opening up God’s Word for God’s people. Specifically, they are for those men currently in pastoral ministry and, as such, are responsible for preaching and teaching God’s Word in congregational settings. Though vocational preaching pastors are our priority, the Workshops are open to those in general teaching ministry: including some lay-preachers, teaching Elders, seminary students or professors, teaching missionaries, and those serving in similar roles. Again, our priority is those who regularly preach or teach from God’s Word.

HOW SHOULD I PREPARE?

During the small groups, you will have an opportunity to get feedback on work you’ve prepared in advance.

events.title: AIPC 2021
events.shortDescription: Topic: Suffering And Pastoral Ministry Pastoral ministry is a difficult calling, with hardships and heartbreaks in the ministry, and struggles and challenges in the personal life. This has always been true but has been e
events.fullDescription:
Topic: Suffering And Pastoral Ministry

Pastoral ministry is a difficult calling, with hardships and heartbreaks in the ministry, and struggles and challenges in the personal life. This has always been true but has been exasperated by the Covid-19 pandemic in the last two years. Shepherding church members has been difficult in a social-distancing world, with several members losing loved ones. In the midst of the mental, emotional, and physical strain of pastoral ministry, this year’s conference seeks to bring biblically grounded refreshment.

We have asked seasoned gospel workers to speak to us and encourage us from God’s Word and from their experiences. We will also have a few Indian pastors speaking into the issue, and seeking to encourage us to persist in faithful service and to encourage our churches to stay rooted in God even in the midst of immense suffering. Apart from the preaching sessions, the panel discussions will see Indian pastors discussing practical implications for the purpose of edifying the participants.

events.title: AIPC 2020
events.shortDescription: TOPIC – Spiritual Disciplines Of The Church And The Pastor. Just as spiritual disciplines are essential for the spiritual lives of individual Christians, they are essential for the life of the body of Christ and fo
events.fullDescription:
TOPIC – Spiritual Disciplines Of The Church And The Pastor.

Just as spiritual disciplines are essential for the spiritual lives of individual Christians, they are essential for the life of the body of Christ and for the life of pastor. In this conference, pastors are encouraged to think through what a church is and what a church needs to do as it pursues biblical faithfulness. The important areas of prayer and sexual purity in the life of the pastor are also covered. Additionally, lessons will be learnt from the example of the puritans in the areas of preaching and worship.

Due to the COVID pandemic, this conference is an online conference, and is also open to church members, in addition to pastors and seminary students.

events.title: AIPC 2019
events.shortDescription: Topic: Church The Bride Of Christ One of the key doctrines that every pastor must grasp is the doctrine of the church. The church is a prized possession of God, and is the “bride” for which Christ gave his life, and so t
events.fullDescription:
Topic: Church The Bride Of Christ

One of the key doctrines that every pastor must grasp is the doctrine of the church. The church is a prized possession of God, and is the “bride” for which Christ gave his life, and so this is not something to be taken lightly or to be innovative about. There are many ideas of what a church is and what should happen in a church, not all of which stand up to the scrutiny of the Bible. In this conference, experienced pastors, and several Indian pastors help to clarify what the church is, and what the church should do.

Topics covered include theological realities of what the church, as well as practical implications for pastoral ministry. Several breakout sessions explore important aspects of pastoral ministry in the local church.

events.title: AIPC 2018
events.shortDescription: Topic: Watch Your Life And Doctrine In the midst of all the busyness and responsibilities that demand the attention of a pastor, if there are two things that cannot be compromised on, they are the pastor’s life and the p
events.fullDescription:
Topic: Watch Your Life And Doctrine

In the midst of all the busyness and responsibilities that demand the attention of a pastor, if there are two things that cannot be compromised on, they are the pastor’s life and the pastor’s doctrine.

We see this clearly in the words of the Apostle Paul to his young protégé Timothy, “Keep a close watch on yourself and on the teaching.” And the seriousness of this charge is clear in what he says next: “Persist in this, for by so doing you will save both yourself and your hearers.” And so, it is always good for pastors to be encouraged to re-evaluate their lives and their doctrine and realign them according to God’s Word. In this conference, men who have been in the ministry for several years teach from God’s Word to encourage pastors to pursue holiness and biblical fidelity.

Equip Indian Churches (EIC) invites you to a one-day conference in Dimapur focused on the theme “A Day in the Word” with expositions from Ephesians chapters 1 and 2. In a time when the church needs strong biblical foundations, this conference seeks to encourage believers through faithful preaching, Christ-centred teaching, and meaningful fellowship.

Join pastors, church leaders, and believers from across the region for a day of learning, encouragement, and spiritual refreshment as we reflect on the riches of the Gospel and God’s saving grace in Christ. The conference will also include opportunities to connect with others, explore resources from For The Truth bookstore, and be strengthened for faithful Christian living and ministry.

We warmly invite you to join us for this special gathering centred on God’s Word.

details.shortDescription: All India Pastors’ Conference
details.fullDescription:
Where Men are Equipped & Renewed
AIPC is a gathering of men who love the church from across India — a space to be grounded in God’s Word, renewed in spirit, and connected with fellow labourers.

Organised by Equip Indian Churches, this conference brings hundreds of men under one roof for teaching, fellowship, and prayer.

 

Conference Theme 2026
“Living as Exiles”
Expositions in 1 Peter
“The grass withers, and the flower falls, but the word of the Lord remains forever. And this word is the good news that was preached to you.”
1 Peter 1:24-25

This year’s conference draws from Peter’s letter to the elect exiles of the Dispersion — reframed as messages to the churches and leaders of the Church in India today.

Together, we will sit under the Word, wrestle with its demands, and be prepared — as Exiles living for Christ in this world.
